title: Plan-Price Credit on the Northgate Protect Accident Claim Service Fee
content:
**Desk note on the credit.** A plan-price credit comes off the claim service fee on a Northgate Protect Accident-tier claim by the plan price paid, which is the plan's one-time charges less any refunds on the plan: the higher credit of $12.00 when it is at least the higher plan price of $400.00, the middle credit of $5.00 when it is at least the middle plan price of $200.00 but below $400.00, and nothing below $200.00.

| Plan price paid (one-time charges less refunds on the plan) | Credit |
|---|---|
| $400.00 or more | $12.00 |
| $200.00 or more but below $400.00 | $5.00 |
| Below $200.00 | Nothing |

## Points of judgement

- The plan price paid is read from the plan's own ledger: the one-time price charged, less every refund booked on the plan.
- *Hypothetical:* a one-time price of $409.00 with no refund is at least $400.00: $12.00. A one-time price of $409.00 with a $20.00 refund leaves $389.00: $5.00.
- *Hypothetical, both sides:* $200.00 earns $5.00; $199.99 earns nothing.
